Based on my search, here's information about Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools:

## Overview

Welch Allyn (now part of Hillrom) is a leading manufacturer of diagnostic medical instruments, founded in 1915 when Dr. Francis A. Welch and William Noah Allyn introduced the first handheld, direct-illuminating ophthalmoscope. The company has pioneered numerous advances in ophthalmic diagnostic technology.

## Key Ophthalmology Tools

### Ophthalmoscopes

Welch Allyn offers three main ophthalmoscope models:

| Model | Field of View | Key Features | Warranty |
|-------|-------------|------------|----------|
| **Traditional/Coaxial** | Standard | Classic design, reliable basic functionality | 1 Year |
| **PanOptic Basic** | 20× larger than standard | DuraShock technology, wider field of view | 1 Year |
| **PanOptic Plus** | 20× larger than standard | DuraShock technology, digital image capture, Quick Eye alignment technology, cobalt blue filter for corneal examination | 5 Years |

**PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope Features:**
- 25-degree field of vision for comprehensive retinal examination without pupil dilation
- Quick Eye™ alignment technology with disc-alignment lights to help direct patient gaze
- DuraShock™ technology for impact resistance
- Long-lasting LED lamps
- Compatible with 3.5V power sources and Li-ion plus power handles
- Allows physicians to maintain distance from patients during examination

### Diagnostic Sets

Welch Allyn diagnostic sets typically include:
- Ophthalmoscope (various models available)
- Otoscope (often MacroView or MacroView Plus)
- Rechargeable power handle (NiCad or Lithium Ion)
- Hard carrying case

Popular configurations include:
- **71PM3LXE-US**: PanOptic Plus LED Ophthalmoscope + MacroView Plus LED Otoscope + Premium Li-Ion USB handle
- **71PM2LXU-US**: PanOptic Basic LED + MacroView Basic LED + Li-Ion Plus handle
- **71SM2CXX**: Coaxial Ophthalmoscope + MacroView Basic LED + NiCad handle
- **71SM2LXU**: Coaxial Ophthalmoscope + MacroView Basic LED + Li-Ion handle
- **71SS2CXX**: Standard ophthalmoscope + standard otoscope + NiCad handle (entry-level)

### Other Ophthalmology Equipment

- **Retinoscopes**: For objective refraction assessment
- **SureSight™ Vision Screener**: Automatic refractor for pediatric vision screening that quickly checks for glasses prescription without requiring patient response
- **Illuminators and Transilluminators**: For various eye examination purposes
- **Slit Lamps**: For detailed anterior segment examination (often included in comprehensive ophthalmology setups)

## Applications

Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools are used for:
- Fundoscopic examinations (retina, optic disc, blood vessels)
- Corneal assessments (especially with cobalt blue filter on PanOptic Plus)
- Detection of systemic diseases affecting small blood vessels and nervous system
- Pediatric vision screening
- Routine eye exams in primary care, emergency departments, urgent care, and specialized clinics
- Documentation and telemedicine (with digital capture capabilities)

## Advanced Features

- **Digital image capture** (PanOptic Plus): For documenting exams and monitoring clinical cases
- **iExaminer Pro App compatibility**: For saving and sharing images
- **Fiber-optic illumination**: Shadow-free lighting
- **LED technology**: Longer-lasting, brighter illumination than traditional halogen
- **LumiView clear ear speculum** (on otoscopes): Four times more brightness than standard specula

Sources:
1. https://cornellsurgical.com/blogs/default-blog/diagnostic-sets-full-comparison-guide?srsltid=AfmBOoo4mJTylX-gl2NUkWpvAANAodyPMHR19BSdX49ibOtoN8Nz_GUQ
2. https://www.dispomed.com/welch-allyn-ophthalmoscope-purchase-guide/
3. https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/
4. https://www.techsciresearch.com/blog/product-review-new-welch-allyn-panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope-and-welch-allyn-macroview-plus-otoscope/213.html
5. https://www.lepekemedical.com/post/product-review-welch-allyn-3-5v-diagnostic-set
6. https://www.steeles.com/catalog/welchallyn_about.html?srsltid=AfmBOoqC2s6-_26D_flgYLK_bE4b8HnbZFuX1k4zy3-VoPLgr1TvCaPM
7. https://www.medscape.com/viewarticle/756180
8. https://angelusmedical.com/blogs/guide/what-is-a-welch-allyn-otoscope-used-for?srsltid=AfmBOoqm1PP7F8WoEUD8oMzWJqOh9-8bIOREgA8J9UsJWs_lwgwPax1U
9. https://mhcfac.com/projects/combination-facilities-more-than-one-1-medical-specialty-in-one-1-mobile-medical-vehicle/
